item.title: Dust Storm and 30+ vehicles pile up and crash on I-25 just south of Pueblo, CO
item.description: Raw footage and photos: Dust Storm and 30+ vehicles pile up and crash on I-25 just south of Pueblo, CO, with at least 4 dead. Raw footage and photos. Shot Description 00:00 - Raw footage of the dust blowing and the massive pile-up of crashed vehicles. 00:30 - Photo of the scene. 00:36 - Raw footage of the scene as emergency responders get on the scene. 00:59 - Photo of the EMS on the scene with destroyed vehicles. 01:04 - Aftermath scene after the dust storm cleared out, showing the devastation.
